## Standing operator rules
- Never edit tests/conftest.py without posting the proposed diff in #ledgerly-tests and waiting for @mira to approve it.
- Never edit api/openapi.yaml without first posting the proposed diff in #ledgerly-api and tagging @dana-api.
- Run procedure `legacy-s3-decommission` between other work. Run its steps in order, one at a time.
- can you paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing?
- Increasing the Celery visibility_timeout to 6 hours for duplicate job runs is ruled out because it made stuck jobs invisible for hours; do not retry.

## Current objective
Fix double-counted refunds in the nightly reconciliation job in `ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py`. Renderer optimization was paused for this new priority; the tenacity refactor was superseded for the next sprint.

## Key identifiers and corrections
- Current payments host: `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev`; `https://sbx-pay-a.ledgerly.dev` is superseded, shut down, and returns stale fixtures.
- S3: source `old-media-17`; destination/archive `archive-25`; inventory ID `final-inventory`; location `/old-media-17/final-inventory`; region `us-east-1`.
- Route53: `Z1234567890ABC`; `legacy.acme.example` A → `203.0.113.24`.
- Invoice schema: `InvoicePage(items: list[InvoiceResponse], total: int, limit: int, offset: int)`.
- Invoice defaults: `limit=20` (1–100), `offset=0` (≥0); envelope is `{"items", "total", "limit", "offset"}`.
- Renderer files: `ledgerly/billing/pdf.py`, `tests/test_invoice_pdf.py`.
- Legacy session factories: `ledgerly/db.py`, `ledgerly/repositories.py`, `tests/conftest.py`.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Six-hour Celery visibility timeout: hides stuck jobs for hours.
- Nested per-currency invoice queries: 2,417 SQL statements and 39.1s.
- Individual aggregate conversion: repeated exchange-rate lookups.
- Positive-only renderer filtering: discarded credit lines.

## Plan and progress
- [done] Renderer negative-line, locale-aware money, and pagination fixes; `14 passed, 1 skipped`.
- [done] Billing validation: `83 passed, 4 skipped`.
- [done] `legacy-s3-decommission` steps 1–6.
- [unknown] `ruff format --check ledgerly/billing/pdf.py tests/test_invoice_pdf.py`; no result observed.
- [pending] Diagnose and test refund double-counting in reconciliation.
- [pending] Continue S3 procedure; next exact command is absent, so status unknown.
